page.background: warm farm green/cream treatment; match approved static art

hero.height: auto from actual asset aspect ratio
hero.crop: none by default; do not clip title, horns, hooves or bell
hero.phase_badge: separate DOM row below hero; min-height 32; grows on wrap
hero.account_action: optional DOM action above hero, at least 48x48; no duplicate large developer header

identity_panel.unbound: short explanation + binding action; no invented balance or 3/3
identity_panel.bound: honor score and remaining formal opportunities; show balance separately only where needed

game_card.cta_label: short label that matches current action; grow/wrap if needed; do not alter navigation behavior
game_card.narrow_rule: 320px width: allow title/body wrap and card height growth; keep min-width:0 for text and no horizontal overflow

footer.navigation: real DOM; content min-height 64 plus safe-area; each item min 48x48; reserve page padding; verify no covered last card

typography.system_body_font: reuse available licensed font with Chinese fallback
typography.fixed_brand_title: artwork allowed with equivalent accessible heading

gameplay.extra_vertical_space: decorative background or normal UI spacing

adjustments: These numbers are construction starts. Record actual DOM metrics and explain responsive changes; pass hierarchy/readability/scene checks, not arbitrary pixel similarity.
